project.name: SkillWeave Initiative 05 — Execution System, Checklists, Memory, and Observability
project.description: Checklist-driven execution loops, persistent project memory, context compaction, selective loading, and execution observability

objectives.description: Build a checklist-driven execution loop that reads, executes, and updates checklist items in a structured cycle
Establish persistent project memory and context compaction for cross-session continuity
Add execution observability with token tracking, runtime metrics, and execution reports

success_metrics.target: Token count and runtime per step

tasks.title: Define execution directory structure and format specifications
tasks.description: Define the .skillweave/ directory layout for memory, checklists, tracking-log, and config. Specify YAML formats for all new file types.
acceptance_criteria: Directory structure documented: memory/, checklists/, tracking-log/
YAML format defined for: memory files, task-log, decisions, learnings, metrics
Checklist format documented (markdown with extensions)
Context summary format defined
All formats are agent-agnostic (plain YAML/Markdown)

tasks.title: Implement checklist loop engine
tasks.description: Core execution loop: read markdown checklist → identify next unchecked item → execute → update status → loop. Supports nested checklists and blocker detection.
acceptance_criteria: Reads markdown checklist files with - [ ] and - [x] syntax
Identifies next unchecked item in sequence
Updates checklist file with completion status after execution
Loops until all items checked or blocker encountered
Supports nested checklists (sub-items under items)
Blocker detection pauses loop and reports issue

tasks.title: Implement project memory layer
tasks.description: Persistent key-value store in .skillweave/memory/ with categories: rules, decisions, conventions, architecture, open-issues. Readable and writable at runtime.
acceptance_criteria: Memory stored as YAML files in .skillweave/memory/
5 categories: rules, decisions, conventions, architecture, open-issues
Read operation loads memory at skill startup
Write operation appends entries during execution
Memory portable across agent frameworks (plain files)
Search by key or category works

tasks.title: Implement context compaction engine
tasks.description: After each major step, produce compact summary: completed_items, key_decisions, current_state, next_steps. Save to tracking-log, loadable as starting context for next step.
acceptance_criteria: Compaction runs after each checklist item completion
Produces structured summary with 4 sections
Summary saved to .skillweave/tracking-log/context-summary.yaml
Summary loadable by next execution step
Original detailed output preserved separately in tracking log

tasks.title: Implement execution observability
tasks.description: Track per-step metrics: step_id, tokens_used, runtime_seconds, success/failure, retries. Generate summary report after execution.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics recorded per step in .skillweave/tracking-log/metrics.yaml
Tracks: step_id, tokens_used, runtime_seconds, success, retries
Summary report generated after execution completes
Cumulative metrics across sessions supported
Report saved to .skillweave/tracking-log/execution-report.md

tasks.title: Implement selective context loader
tasks.description: Load only files and sections needed for current step. Each checklist item can declare required_context. Default context: memory + current checklist + last summary.
acceptance_criteria: Checklist items can declare required_context (file paths, sections)
Loader reads only declared context
Default context includes: memory, checklist, last context summary
Overridable with explicit context specification
Measurably less context than full-load approach

tasks.title: Implement artifact-first progress tracking
tasks.description: Decision log, learning log, and task log as append-only YAML files. All progress written to files instead of remaining in chat.
acceptance_criteria: Decision log at .skillweave/tracking-log/decisions.yaml
Learning log at .skillweave/tracking-log/learnings.yaml
Task log at .skillweave/tracking-log/task-log.yaml
Each entry has timestamp, context, and rationale
Logs are append-only

tasks.title: Implement correction by regeneration
tasks.description: When a step fails, retry from clean state using last good context summary. Track retry count, max retries configurable, human review after max retries.
acceptance_criteria: Failed steps marked in checklist with failure reason
Retry creates fresh context from last good summary
Retry count tracked per item
Max retries configurable (default: 3)
After max retries, item flagged for human review

tasks.title: Integrate execution system with existing skills
tasks.description: Connect checklist loop, memory, compaction, and observability to existing SkillWeave skill infrastructure. Ensure backward compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: Skills can opt into checklist-driven execution
Memory layer loadable from any skill
Observability metrics collected during skill execution
Existing skill invocations work unchanged
Execution system is opt-in via config

tasks.title: Comprehensive test suite for execution system
tasks.description: Tests for checklist loop, memory, compaction, observability, selective loading, artifact tracking, correction, and integration.
acceptance_criteria: Test file exists with 18+ test cases
Checklist loop tests pass
Memory round-trip tests pass
Compaction output validation tests pass
Observability metrics tests pass
Backward compatibility tests pass
All tests run without errors

assumptions.description: YAML-based file persistence is sufficient for project memory
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: May need database or more structured storage
assumptions.validation_method: Test with projects having 100+ memory entries

assumptions.description: Markdown checklist format is expressive enough for all execution patterns
assumptions.validation_method: Map 5 real workflows to checklist format

technical: All state as plain files (YAML, Markdown) — no databases
Agent-agnostic: works across Claude, OpenCode, Gemini
Execution system is opt-in via config

risks.description: Checklist format too rigid for complex workflows
risks.mitigation: Support nested checklists and conditional items
Preserve full output in tracking log, compaction is summary only

risks.description: Memory files grow large over time

execution_recommendation.reason: 10 tasks, ~8 hours total, complex dependencies, core infrastructure work
